description: Add a 'Share Progress' feature that lets users share their streak, health score, and daily stats as a styled card/image. This drives viral growth through social sharing (key revenue lever: user acquisition at zero cost). Also add scheduled daily hydration/food reminders via local notifications to boost retention.
steps: Create a new file lib/widgets/share_progress_card.dart that builds a shareable widget showing: current pushup streak, today's health score (0-10), calories eaten vs target, water intake vs target, and the app branding ('HealthPush - Earn your screen time'). Style it using existing AppColors, AppRadius, AppSpacing tokens. Include a static method to render the widget to image bytes using RepaintBoundary + RenderRepaintBoundary.toImage.

Create a new file lib/screens/home/share_progress_screen.dart - a simple screen that shows the progress card preview and a 'Share' button. When tapped, it captures the card as an image and uses Flutter's share mechanism (use the `Share.shareXFiles` pattern by writing bytes to a temp file and sharing). Since we cannot add the `share_plus` package (not in pubspec), instead use a MethodChannel to invoke Android's native share intent via the existing PlatformChannelService pattern OR simply copy the stats as text to clipboard with a success snackbar. Prefer the clipboard approach since it requires no new dependencies.

In lib/screens/home/dashboard_tab.dart: Add a share button (Icon: Icons.share_rounded) to the _StreakCard widget that navigates to the ShareProgressScreen, OR add it to the _GreetingRow as a second action button.

In lib/services/notification_service.dart: Add methods `scheduleHydrationReminders()` and `scheduleFoodLogReminder()` that use flutter_local_notifications' zonedSchedule or periodicallyShow to send reminders at fixed intervals (e.g., every 2 hours for water from 8am-10pm, and at 12:30pm/7:30pm for food logging).
In lib/services/notification_service.dart: Call the scheduling methods from `initialize()` after channel creation, so reminders are auto-scheduled on app start.
Update DAILY_SUMMARY.md with today's findings, fixes, and new features.
acceptance_criteria: A ShareProgressScreen exists and is reachable from the dashboard
The share card displays streak, health score, calories, water data with app branding
Users can copy their stats to clipboard (or share as text) to share externally
Notification service schedules hydration reminders at reasonable intervals
Notification service schedules food logging reminders for lunch and dinner times
DAILY_SUMMARY.md is updated with today's work
No new dependencies added to pubspec.yaml (use only existing packages)
All code follows existing patterns: relative imports, AppColors/AppTheme usage, Provider for state access
verification: Review share_progress_card.dart and share_progress_screen.dart for correct Widget structure and imports
Verify dashboard_tab.dart has a working navigation path to the share screen
Review notification_service.dart scheduling logic for correct use of flutter_local_notifications API
Grep for any absolute imports or firebase references - should find none
